abstract: Release and submission guide for Capacitor apps on the Apple App Store and Google Play: current SDK and target API deadlines (iOS 26 SDK since April 2026, iOS 27 SDK from April 2027, UIScene for Xcode 27, Play API 36 from August 31 2026, 16 KB page size), version/build numbers, signing, archive and upload paths, TestFlight, Play tracks and the 12-tester closed test, privacy manifest and forms, icons and screenshot sizes, phased rollout, verification, and exact upload error fixes. Platform detail in references/.
